dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Major depressive disorder presenting with persistent fatigue
Alternative 1: Chronic insomnia or undiagnosed sleep disorder causing daytime fatigue
Alternative 2: Medication- or substance-related fatigue (e.g., undisclosed sedative use)
Alternative 3: Somatic symptom disorder / medically unexplained fatigue
